card.name: Center in institution names
card.fires_on: The word Center or Centre when it is the last part of a named institution, right after a proper name or National/German, such as Dana Centre or National Center for Physics.

modes.label: After a person or place name
modes.description: Center or Centre follows a surname or place name to form a named institute.

modes.label: After National or German
modes.description: Center follows a national adjective at the start of a research institute name, often before for.
